info.prompt: A high-stakes cyber-gothic casino interface where the game board is an obsidian neural grid pulsating with bioluminescent cyan and magenta circuitry, framed by skeletal gold filigree resembling cathedral arches, with translucent gem-like dice tiles casting prismatic glows across the void-black background, terminal-style hacker text scrolling along the bottom edge in electric green, and a vignette effect pulling focus to the center where a wild scatter event triggers arterial crimson particle explosions.
